(a)  Minimum number of stages (total-reflux)

Fenske equation for a binary mixture (light component = LK):

Nmin = ln[ (xD/xHK,D) (xHK,B/xB) ] / ln α

xHK,D = 1 – xD = 0.05
xHK,B = 1 – xB = 0.95

Numerator = (0.95/0.05)(0.95/0.05) = 19 × 19 = 361  
ln 361 = 5.88888

Denominator = ln α = ln 2.5 = 0.91629

Nmin = 5.88888 / 0.91629 = 6.43 theoretical stages  
(Partial reboiler counted as one stage.)

(b)  Minimum reflux ratio

For a saturated-liquid feed, use the Underwood method (q = 1).

Step 1: Underwood root θ (choose the root between αHK and αLK, i.e. 1 < θ < 2.5)

Solve  Σ (q zi)/(αi – θ) = 1 :

0.4/(2.5 – θ) + 0.6/(1 – θ) = 1  ⇒  θ ≈ 2.23

Step 2: Minimum reflux ratio

Rmin = Σ xD,i αi / (αi – θ) – 1

For the LK (α = 2.5): 0.95×2.5/(2.5–2.23) = 2.375/0.27 = 8.796  
For the HK (α = 1):   0.05×1/(1–2.23)  = 0.05/–1.23 = –0.0406

Σ = 8.796 – 0.0406 = 8.756  
Rmin = 8.756 – 1 = 7.76

FINAL (a): 6.43 stages  
FINAL (b): 7.76 -
